steps.text: Whatever your role, signing in brings you here. This page is not about one community: it gathers what concerns you, personally, across all of them.
steps.title: Your home page

steps.text: The band at the top counts what is waiting on you: invitations received, a record to complete, unread notifications. When there is nothing, it collapses to a single reassuring line.
steps.title: What needs you

steps.text: Each card shows a community and your role in it. The button opens it: that community becomes your active one and you land on its dashboard.
steps.title: My communities

steps.text: The panel gathers your meters across every community for the latest month with readings. A meter with no reading says "no reading yet" rather than showing a misleading zero.
steps.title: My energy

steps.text: Invoices to pay and the documents shared with you are gathered here. Invoices only show up for communities that use the billing module.
steps.title: My invoices and my documents

steps.text: The last panel flags the official documents sent to the regulator that mention you. The button opens the detail inside the community concerned.
steps.title: What has been filed about me

steps.text: Every row of the band is a shortcut to the screen where the action happens: the invitations list, your member record, or your notifications.
steps.title: Deal with what is waiting

steps.text: Here, an unread notification: the shortcut opens the notifications page, where you can read it and mark it as read.
steps.title: Straight to the right place
